verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Indian data residency for deployments where data must stay in India, and it offers self-hosting via Docker or Kubernetes on your own servers, which gives location control. However, the managed-cloud option shows only one residency region and no documented way to choose it. missing for 10: documented choice of multiple managed regions (e.g., US/EU), a documented mechanism for selecting residency per account or agent, residency coverage for third-party providers in the call path, independent corroboration.
